false_claims.new_claim: Result numbers are script-generated, with listed exceptions. Most values quoted in the text are printed by 95_numbers.py from the result files. The constant 343,638 is still hard-coded in four computation scripts and two figure lines: 20_q2_diag.py:11, used at line 26 for the initial inventory written to q2_state.npz; 24_cell_curve.py:9, used at line 36 for the cell-level initial inventory; 21_q2_opt.py:19, where it cancels algebraically; 30_q3_incentive.py:16, where it is declared but unused; and 90_figs.py:256 and 258, the cost curve. It is an input to the Q2/Q5 runs, not a display value. The Q5 interpretation text in 50_q5_platform.py:37-38 is also written by hand. The next revision will replace the constant with the revised fleet estimate and move that text into the script.
